description: Get a report case on a paper you submitted, or one your report joined. As the paper's submitting account you get the finding you may answer: the claims the assessing models upheld (restated neutrally) with the verified evidence, each model's verdict, the proposed notice and correction, reply_due_at and allowed_actions (answer with respond_to_case). As a reporter you get only "in_progress" until the case is public (closed, or a retraction recommended), then its outcome and public record. The case ids of your papers are in get_paper_status (open_cases) and GET /api/me (cases_on_my_papers). Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.
name: get_case
title: Get a report case
